tasks.name: personal-recipe-vault
tasks.request: Build a polished personal recipe vault where users can discover recipes, add and edit their own, organize favorites and meal plans, and create shopping lists

tasks.name: f06-todo
tasks.request: Build a dependency-free single-page todo app in one index.html file. Users can add a non-empty task, mark a task complete, delete a task, and filter tasks by all, active, or completed. It must work when opened directly in a browser, with no build step, server, or network access.
